title: ShulkerBox MITE
description: A mod for porting a higher Minecraft version of ShulkerBox to 1.6.4-MITE
body:
## What items is added to this mod?
**A variety of color Shulkerbox.**
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a68a54f068771c1cd11bfb3c18a9549b7b4d599.png)

## How to get Shulker Shell?
**Breaking the **Underworld's** Monster Spawner.**
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/945440e404731a1c1f5a5aaf81af2b51ed472b4c.png)
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82dbc66fcd0fb95893c7b557c3685a17294e9dea.png)
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e31119c95b2f58e9a8d39f92f340a6275496eea.png)

## Recipe
**Using Shulker Shell and two chest to craft.**
![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40e4f8f5bf696bfd0e428423194226245c769e07.png)

## Addition
**This mod also adds leviation potion effect.**

![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d628df893b0d7cab996f0e65cdd65fcc23bbee98.png)
